author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Shows a compact Twitch upcoming-ad and active-ad countdown without controlling ad playback.
changelog: 4.0.3: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.0.3, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 4.0.2: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.0.2, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 4.0.1: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.0.1, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 4.0.0: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.0.0, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 3.6.0: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 3.6.0, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 3.5.0: Twitch-only Upcoming Ad and Ad Run intake, fail-closed persisted timing, separate upcoming/active offline previews, and a compact browser overlay.

manifest.name: Ad Break Companion
installationSteps: Install and enable the add-on, then review the countdown wording and colors.
Import the bundled Streamer.bot package into its own THSV Addon - Ad Break Companion group.
Attach Twitch > Ads > Upcoming Ad to the Upcoming Ad Intake action.
Attach Twitch > Ads > Ad Run to the Ad Run Intake action.
Add the Ad Break Companion overlay URL shown by the wizard to OBS, Meld, or Streamlabs Desktop.
Run Preview Upcoming and Preview Active while offline to size both states, then run Clear Display.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall the add-on. Its small timing state remains unless add-on data is explicitly deleted.

healthChecks.description: Confirms Twitch ad timing events, bounded scheduling, persistence, and overlay publishing.
